login.meta_description: Log in to your Melpis dashboard to manage your AI WhatsApp assistant, live reservations, and team shared inbox.
login.heading: Log in to Melpis
login.subtitle: Manage your assistant, bookings, and knowledge base from a unified dashboard. Secure session: no credentials exposed to the browser.

recover.instructions: Enter the email associated with your account: if an account exists, you'll receive a password reset link.
recover.success: If your email is registered, you will receive password reset instructions within a few minutes.

reset.instructions: Set a new password: minimum 10 characters and at least one special symbol.
reset.success: Password successfully updated! Redirecting to login...

register.page_title: Create Your Account · 7-Day Free Trial | Melpis
register.meta_description: Get started with your WhatsApp AI assistant in 5 minutes. 7-day free trial, no credit card required, automated bookings and dedicated support.
register.heading: Create your account
register.subtitle: AI WhatsApp assistant for your business. Free trial: 7 days or 150 messages, no credit card required.
register.password_placeholder: At least 10 characters with a symbol
register.terms_agree: I have read the Privacy Policy and agree to the Terms of Service.
register.success_body: If this address can be registered, you will receive a link. Open it to confirm your address, then log in with the password you chose.

messages.register_failed: Sign-up was unsuccessful. Please try again shortly.
messages.new_password_help: Choose a new password for your account.
messages.password_updated: Password updated. You can now log in with your new password.
messages.login_help: Manage your assistant, bookings, and documents from a single platform.
